ADANIENT.attchmntText: Adani Enterprises Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "Media Release on the subject  Adani Wind Begins Production of India's Longest Wind Turbine Blade; 5 MW Platform Certified for Serial Production ".
ADANIENT.voiceSummary: Adani Enterprises Limited submitted a media release regarding its subsidiary Adani New Industries Limited. Adani Wind has commenced production of India's longest wind turbine blades, measuring 91.2 metres, at its facility in Mundra, Gujarat. These blades are designed for the MWL185-5.0 MW turbine platform. The platform has received certification from WindGuard Certification GmbH for serial production. The turbine features a 185-metre rotor diameter and a 140-metre hub height. This development strengthens domestic wind manufacturing capabilities. Adani Wind holds three turbine platforms on the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy's Approved List. The company is ranked in BloombergNEF's Global Top 15 turbine manufacturers for 2025. Cumulative orders from independent power producers outside the Adani Group now exceed 1 GW.

TATAPOWER.attchmntText: Tata Power Company Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "Tata Power Renewables Commissions 100.8 MW Wind Project in Ausa, Maharashtra".
TATAPOWER.voiceSummary: Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited commissioned its 100.8 MW wind project in Ausa, Maharashtra, on November 16, 2026. The facility supplies renewable power to Tata Power Mumbai Distribution and is expected to generate 308 million units of electricity annually. This output is projected to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by approximately 252,560 tonnes each year. The project utilizes 28 horizontal axis wind turbine generators. Its commissioning brings Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited's total renewable utility capacity to 12.1 GW. Of this total, 7.3 GW is currently operational, consisting of 5.9 GW from solar and 1.4 GW from wind energy. The remaining 4.8 GW is under various stages of implementation. The company noted that the project involved a first-of-its-kind monopole extra high voltage line installation. This announcement is for reference and is not a disclosure under Regulation 30 of SEBI regulations.

HINDZINC.attchmntText: Hindustan Zinc Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
HINDZINC.voiceSummary: Hindustan Zinc Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the HZL 2.0 Growth Program on November 16, 2026. The initiative aims to increase metal production capacity from 1.1 MTPA to 2.0 MTPA. The project requires an estimated capital expenditure of INR 80,000 crore over a period of 3 to 5 years. Financing will be sourced through internal accruals and debt. The expansion includes a 265 KTPA integrated zinc smelter at Debari and a new 500 KTPA zinc smelter with a 200 KTPA lead smelter. BIOCON.attchmntText: Biocon Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 16, 2026, titled "Biocon Gets U.S. FDA Approval for Pebrilzo  (pertuzumab-qcay) Injection, a Biosimilar to Perjeta®, Expanding Its Oncology Portfolio".
BIOCON.voiceSummary: Biocon Limited announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Pebrilzo, a biosimilar to Perjeta, for treating HER2-positive breast cancer. This approval marks Biocon's fifth oncology biosimilar in the United States. The company has secured a global settlement and license agreement with Genentech, enabling the earliest licensed launch of Pebrilzo in the United States in the third quarter of calendar year 2028. Additionally, the European Medicines Agency previously issued a positive opinion recommending marketing authorization for the product in Europe. The press release details clinical indications, warnings regarding cardiac dysfunction and embryo-fetal toxicity, and common adverse reactions associated with the treatment.

GESHIP.voiceSummary: The Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited filed transcripts of its earnings call held on November 11, 2026, regarding financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Executive Director and CFO G. Shivakumar reported a profitable quarter with the highest ever net asset value. An interim dividend of INR14.40 per share was maintained. Suezmax spot earnings spiked due to risk premiums in the Strait of Hormuz and Black Sea, excluding these areas, average earnings were USD350,000 to USD400,000 per day. Rates subsequently dropped to USD130,000 to USD150,000 per day due to shuttle services reducing efficiency. Product tanker rates remain strong at USD50,000 to USD60,000 per day. Dry bulk earnings are profitable, with Capesize rates at USD30,000 to USD35,000 per day. LPG spot rates reached USD140,000 per day, though the company’s fleet is on fixed time charters. The company added two vessels, Jag Amit and Jag Vikrant, and committed to a Kamsarmax and a new Suezmax. Two Suezmaxes were fixed on one-year charters.

TACC has signed a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding with a global automotive OEM. The agreement aims to explore the supply of fast-charging anode materials for electric vehicles. Tenaclidine Phase-1 study is completed, with nonclinical toxicity studies in progress. Suven Life Sciences is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on central nervous system disorders.
